title: Krispy Kreme Donut
hookLine: United States-inspired krispy kreme donut with 14 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Dissolve yeast in warm water in 2 1/2-quart bowl. Add milk, sugar, salt, eggs, shortening and 2 cups flour. Beat on low for 30 seconds, scraping bowl constantly. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in remaining flour until smooth. Cover and let rise until double, 50-60 minutes. (Dough is ready when indentation remains when touched.) Turn dough onto floured surface; roll around lightly to coat with flour. Gently roll dough 1/2-inch thick with floured rolling pin. Cut with floured doughnut cutter. Cover and let rise until double, 30-40 minutes. Incorporate {m53015_1}, {m53015_2}, {m53015_3}, and {m53015_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure yeast first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat vegetable oil in deep fryer to 350°. Slide doughnuts into hot oil with wide spatula. Turn doughnuts as they rise to the surface. Fry until golden brown, about 1 minute on each side. Remove carefully from oil (do not prick surface); drain. Dip the doughnuts into creamy glaze set on rack. Incorporate {m53015_5}, {m53015_6}, and {m53015_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53015_8}, {m53015_9}, {m53015_10}, {m53015_11}, {m53015_12}, {m53015_13}, and {m53015_14} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat butter until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until desired consistency.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
